citations.quote: This market resolves to Yes if Tijuana wins the Liga MX match between Tijuana and Atlante scheduled for November 20, 2026 at 10:00 PM ET, based only on regulation time plus stoppage time and excluding extra time and penalties. Otherwise, it resolves to No. The Underlying is the official result of the specified sporting event after regulation time plus stoppage time only. Source Agencies, in order, are the Liga MX governing body, ESPN, Fox Sports, and the broadcast partner of the event. If the Expiration Value cannot be determined on the Expiration Date (including because the event is cancelled or a team forfeits, withdraws, or is disqualified), the Exchange may determine payouts pursuant to the Market Outcome Review Process. workbook_conflicts: Scale: the README specifies 1-5 per category; the workbook uses 1-3. This prototype uses the workbook's 1-3 scale and 4-12 totals.

Markets!B formula =IF(I>=9,"High",IF(I>=7,"Medium","Low")) ignores the Framework overrides, and SUM() treats a blank score as 0, so an incomplete row shows as Low. The code reports incomplete ratings instead.
Volume column mixes bases: rows 2-4 are event totals from the Gemini API, rows 5-6 are 24h figures from CoinRithm, while Agent rule 4 is written for 24h volume.
Override 'any 3 in Ambiguity or Source -> at least Medium' only changes the result at a raw total of 6 (for example 3+1+1+1); at 7 or more the total is already Medium.
Override 'High (3) in Liquidity -> never trade more than top-of-book' is a trading rule. Verity places no trades, so it becomes a note that the price is an unreliable signal.
Agent action column uses trading verbs (Proceed, Proceed small size). They are mapped to research actions: Low -> no_further_research, Medium -> investigate, High -> flag_for_human_review.
